sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: These Terms of Use (hereinafter the "Terms") set out the conditions governing access to and use of the Espace service operated by the Lychen association (hereinafter the "Service"). Espace is a platform connecting people who have a growing space (land, garden, cellar, etc.) with people who wish to grow food, as part of an approach to food autonomy and social connection. The Service consists of the presentation website, the application available at app.espace.lychen.org and the application programming interface (API) available at api.espace.lychen.org.
